trajectory: single normal PowerSGD+ trajectory; telemetry only, no parameter-update change
caveats: Signals use the first 100000 elements of each bucket and are not full-model norms.
Residual ratios use local raw gradients; dense-gradient ratios use the sampled pre-EF all-reduce.
The cross and quadratic terms are individually large and largely cancel in signed aggregate; this is evidence of sensitivity, not a full counterfactual loss comparison.
Steps 301 and 330 are excluded from window aggregates because 301 is a restart step and the final callback has incomplete bucket coverage.
